english.title: Driver of vehicle involved in accident at Manchester Airport failed to stop and give details
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 7.2 of the Manchester Airport PLC Byelaws 2024.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a vehicle
involved in an accident
which occurred
on a part of Manchester Airport
to which the road traffic enactments did not apply
and by which personal injury occurred to another person or
damage was caused to
another vehicle / an animal other than one in your vehicle / property construed on, fixed to, growing in
or otherwise forming part of the land
on which the road in question was situated or
land adjacent to such land
failed to stop and give to an airport official / a constable
through the published airport emergency telephone number
his / her name and address and
the name and address of the owner of the vehicle and
the registration number / identification marks of the vehicle and
the details of the accident or
provide such information as was otherwise requested
to an airport official or constable,
as soon as reasonably practicable
but in any event no later than 24 hours after the accident
